newsitem.title: USA: FedEx interested in Airbus freighter plan.
newsitem.headline: FedEx interested in Airbus freighter plan.

text.p: Federal Express Corp is definitely interested in the proposed freighter version of the Airbus Industrie consortium's A3XX large passenger aircraft, FedEx Chairman Frederick Smith told reporters.
"I hope they build it. I believe the first manufacturer who makes a 600 passenger aircraft will be successful with it, " he said on Wednesday.
"Air transport is being driven by the need for cheaper and cheaper seats. A big plane is needed to bring down costs. If Airbus builds the A3XX it will be successful, " he added.
"Potentially the A3XX is a very productive plane with a lot of capacity," Smith said, but declined to be more precise on that capacity.
FedEx recently hosted in Memphis the first Airbus Industrie A3XX freighter and combi-aircraft working group.
"If Boeing Co. had gone ahead with its plans (for a similar aircraft) we would have been interested as well, but the A3XX looks better for our needs," Smith added.
"We're not just looking for an aircraft that is just marginally bigger than our McDonnell Douglas MD-11 freighters. And the A3XX is much bigger, he said.
Smith added the A3XX freighter would be able to carry substantially more than Boeing's existing 747-400 freighter.
And although the 747-400 can carry a larger payload than the MD-11F, there were also container compatibility problems between the 747 and other aircraft.
"The MD-11F has the same tonne load cost as the 747 but the MD-11s (operational) plane costs are 30 percent lower, " Smith said. (( Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44-171-542-7706 Fax
